checkpoints.description: [2/3] Redrew the five residents as connected hooded figures and the ruins statue and forest tree as real silhouettes; [3/3] rooms now sit on a tiling biome backdrop at 55 percent and living enemy frames carry a top-left rim light. Verified: six-biome Playwright sweep with zero console errors, NPC and prop previews reviewed at 3x, typecheck and 151 tests pass, 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-polish-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Redrew the six remaining biome obstacle props as readable silhouettes: the abyss coral as a branching fan with polyp tips, the foundry cog pillar as a riveted column under a toothed gear, the frost ice spire as a shard cluster on a frozen shelf, the hive as hexagonal wax cells with drips, the catacomb bone pile as crossed femurs and a skull with sockets, and the sanctuary altar as a tiered stone slab with a floating memory core. Verified in situ across all thirteen biomes with zero console errors; sprite previews reviewed at 1.7x; 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-props-v2' completed successfully.

[1/1] Gave the eight bare biome backdrops real silhouettes: burnt trunks and a broken arch for ash, sunken arches and kelp for abyss, jagged ridges for frost, blossoms over arches for bloom, chimney stacks and pipe gantries for foundry, leaning swamp trees with hanging moss for mire, stacked hexagonal comb chambers for hive, and receding tomb niches for catacomb. All thirteen biomes verified in situ with zero console errors; 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-backdrops-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Reworked the Memory Walker's head: a deep shadowed face cavity under the hood with two glowing eyes and a hint of jaw, plus a cloak rim highlight on the leading hood edge. The blank tan oval read as a featureless blob at gameplay scale. Verified across idle, attack and greatsword frames at 3x and in a fresh ruins run with zero console errors; typecheck and 151 tests pass; 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-hero-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Fixed a real art defect: the shrine interactable had no sprite and fell through to the fountain mapping, so every shrine rendered as a second memory fountain. Added a dedicated shrine sprite (stepped base, pillars, gabled hood, memory flame, offerings) and a proper floor lever (base plate, pivot housing, brass handle), wired shrine into interactableLook. Verified in-game in the void section with zero console errors; 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-interact-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Split the shared two-dot eye motif into six archetype motifs (pair, slits, single, many, hollow, glare) behind an _enemy_eyes helper, and assigned motifs to fifteen enemies so families stop reading as the same blob: hollow for shadow and forgotten, single cyclops for voidWalker, bogLeech and leviathan, triple for prismEntity, voidCantor, hiveDrone, hiveGuard, mireSovereign, slit visors for solderWisp, plagueCaster, catacombArcher, angled glare for spirit and graveHound. All 35 enemy sheets reviewed before and after, in-game biome sweep with zero console errors, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-eyes-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Added three variants each for the four floor deco kinds (crack, rubble, moss, glyph) and picked one per tile from the stable tile hash, so a floor of cracks no longer reads as a single stamped pattern. Cracks get three different origins and a spur variant, glyphs get a circle ward, a four-point ward and concentric arcs, moss gets a creeping-corner variant, rubble a chunkier one. Typecheck, lint, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass; two biome captures reviewed with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-deco-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Added deterministic view-only room dressing: one or two small wall-base props per dungeon room, per-biome from existing atlas props (barrel, crate, bone pile, herbs, lantern, brazier, coral, comb, candle). Placement is seeded from the room rectangle, skips doorways and glyphs, never touches the simulation, and is disabled in Sanctuary interiors. Verified in ruins and catacombs with zero console errors; typecheck, lint, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-dressing-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Rebuilt the final boss renderer: the Keeper was a flat tan trapezoid with a stick staff at 192px. It now has a double-ring radiant halo with a crown of rays, a layered robe with lit inner stole, hem band and gold sashes, a shoulder mantle with a lit edge, crossed sleeves with gold cuffs, a shadowed hood with a gold circlet and glaring eyes, a tall crozier with a spiral head and a floating memory gem, and drifting blessing motes. Also audited live effect layers: telegraphs, projectile glows, hit flash, damage numbers and the lever prompt all render correctly, and confirmed the runtime particle system is procedural (fxArt.ts) while sprites/particles and two UI icons are unused legacy. Verified in the live Keeper fight with zero console errors; 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-keeper-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Rebuilt the Bone Tyrant: tattered ragged-hem cloak, layered spiked bone pauldrons, ribbed breastplate with sternum jewel, skull with heavy jaw, teeth, hollow sockets and a five-spike crown with gem, plus a shortened great cleaver that no longer clips the frame. Gave the Void Cantor a dedicated cantor archetype instead of reusing the small hunched body at scale 1.0: hovering choral robe fraying into ribbons, shoulder cowl with stole ends, deep hood with three eyes and a singing mouth, conducting arms with bony fingers and orbiting hymn glyphs. Also mapped all 52 enemy sprite keys and found 17 late enemies still borrow older sheets with only a tint (documented as intentional). Bone Tyrant verified in the live catacombs fight; Void Cantor sheet reviewed and its key mapping confirmed (void_cantor and void_herald both resolve to voidCantor); zero console errors; 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-bosses2-v1' completed successfully.
